title: Concorde Stretched 10 Inches During Every Flight

scenes.text: Concorde got about ten inches longer every time it flew.
Flying at twice the speed of sound heated its metal skin.
The nose could reach over 250 degrees Fahrenheit.
The heat made the whole airframe expand by up to ten inches.
Engineers painted it special white paint to help shed the heat.
Then it cooled and shrank back, again and again.

description:
Concorde got about ten inches longer every time it flew.
At twice the speed of sound its skin heated up, the nose reached over 250 degrees Fahrenheit, and the airframe stretched. A special white paint helped shed the heat.
Would you fly it?
first_comment: A jet that grew mid-flight. Would you have paid to fly it?
